dependencies.networkBehavior: No document loading or ambient network access

dependencies.name: n3
dependencies.role: Turtle, TriG, N-Triples, and N-Quads syntax adapters only
conformanceEvidence: Independent owlapi-js Turtle classification and adapter-contract suites required in Phase 9; N-Triples, N-Quads, and TriG scopes follow in Phases 12, 13, and 14
dependencies.maintenanceStatus: Pinned production release with active standards test scripts
dependencies.networkBehavior: Parser APIs consume caller-provided input and do not resolve documents
dependencies.browserCost: Conditionally import after strict format selection; establish initial-bundle, lazy-chunk, first-use, heap, and main-thread baselines in Phase 9 and remeasure the added modes in Phases 12 through 14
dependencies.noticeAction: Retain the dependency and transitive dependency licences in release notices

dependencies.name: rdfxml-streaming-parser
conformanceEvidence: Separate owlapi-js adapter classification and contract suites required in Phase 6
dependencies.maintenanceStatus: Pinned production release; XML/security behavior is revalidated in Phase 6
dependencies.networkBehavior: Streaming parser consumes supplied XML; the owlapi-js adapter forbids external-entity retrieval
dependencies.browserCost: Streaming/XML dependency surface; establish heap and bundle baselines in Phase 6
dependencies.noticeAction: Retain the dependency and transitive dependency licences in release notices

dependencies.name: jsonld
dependencies.role: JSON-LD expansion and direct RDF conversion adapter only
conformanceEvidence: Separate owlapi-js adapter classification and contract suites required in Phase 15
dependencies.maintenanceStatus: Pinned production release; restricted-loader behavior is revalidated in Phase 15
dependencies.networkBehavior: Upstream supports document loading; owlapi-js must always inject its default-deny controlled loader
dependencies.browserCost: Largest selected adapter surface; lazy loading and a Phase 15 bundle baseline are mandatory
dependencies.noticeAction: Retain the dependency and transitive dependency licences in release notices

dependencies.name: @xmldom/xmldom
dependencies.role: Node-only DOM implementation behind the OWL/XML parser adapter; browsers use the native DOMParser
dependencies.maintenanceStatus: Pinned production release; revalidate XML error handling, security policy and browser exclusion at every material upgrade
dependencies.networkBehavior: Parses caller-provided XML in memory and performs no document loading or ambient network access
dependencies.browserCost: Node-only fallback behind XmlParserAdapter; browser execution uses native DOMParser and the dependency must remain absent from browser bundles
dependencies.noticeAction: Retain the dependency licence in release notices
